title: Cush
summary: Firstborn son of Ham (Gen 10:6); father of Nimrod (Gen 10:8).
description: Firstborn son of Ham (Gen 10:6); father of Nimrod (Gen 10:8). Josephus (Antiquities I.6.2, Whiston): "the Ethiopians, over whom he reigned, are even at this day ... called Chusites"

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

birth.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH dates the Table-of-Nations framework (first territorial division AP-27, 2254 BC; final division AP-28, 2247 BC; Dispersion AP-2, 2192/2191 BC) but not this individual birth
Jones gives no birth year for Table-of-Nations names.
Ussher (Annals) gives no birth year for this name.

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §8 "The Table of Nations", table "An Hypothetical Chronology for the Table of Nations"
birth.note: Jordan: "If we assume births every two years, and about 30 years between generations ... we can come up with an approximate series of dates" (hypothetical, not stated by Scripture).

reign.date: from the founding of Babel in 2233 B.C.
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "The First Dynasties of Uruk and Kish"
reign.note: Cush's reign at Babel "could be counted as 42.5 years from the founding of Babel in 2233 B.C." (other counts: 55 years from 2247 B.C. or 62 years from the first division). Berossus Dynasty 1 (AP-38) runs 2233—2191 B.C.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Kish I", p. 50
reign.note: Row "Gišur (Cush)" of Table 5 (Kish I dynasty). CFAH-15 identifies Gišur of Kish I with Cush.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Uruk I", p. 52
reign.note: Row "Meš-ki'ag-gašer" of Table 5 (Uruk I dynasty). CFAH-15 identifies Meš-ki'ag-gašer of Uruk I with Cush.
